entry.title: v1.2.2-build5 released
entry.summary: The rendering path can now be chosen from the API. Call blink_gtk_set_gpu_mode() before blink_gtk_init() and the engine starts on that path. Asking for EGL through blink_web_view_new_with_gpu_mode() did not change the path, so applications that did not also set BLINKGTK_GPU_MODE were running on the CPU pixel path. blink_web_view_get_gpu_mode() now reports the path actually in use. The rendering engine remains Chromium 153.0.8010.36.

entry.title: v1.2.2-build4 released
entry.summary: Fixed a problem where the GPU path (BLINKGTK_GPU_MODE=egl) stayed blank from start to finish on systems using a Virtio GPU, such as virtual machines: frames that did have content were judged empty and withheld from display. Pages without animation were the most affected, staying blank for as long as they were open. Assistive technology started after the application now reaches the content as well. The rendering engine remains Chromium 153.0.8010.36.

entry.title: v1.2.2-build3 released
entry.summary: Closing the window before a page finished loading no longer crashes. Opening a book and closing it right away triggered it; the workaround (waiting for the load to finish) is no longer needed. This build also adds a diagnostic that asks the compositor whether a frame reached the screen (printed only with BLINKGTK_GX_LOG=1; nothing changes by default). The rendering engine remains Chromium 153.0.8010.36.

entry.title: v1.2.2-build2 released
entry.summary: Corrects an error in the release notes shipped with build1. They said our previous workaround had been removed; it had not, and it is still present in this release. The wording now matches the artifact. The API reference heading also still read “Target version: BlinkGTK 1.2.1 (Chromium 152.0.7977.64)” from one release back; it now states the actual version. The program is otherwise identical to build1 and typeset output does not change; what changes is the version shown in the bundled documents and the reported version string, now 1.2.2-build2. The error was found through an enquiry from BlinkGTK-Readium.

entry.title: v1.2.2-build1 released
entry.summary: In vertical writing, a line no longer breaks half-way when a closing bracket falls at the line end. A line with room for 35 characters held only 17, and text-align: justify then doubled the inter-character advance. Of 13 configurations, 8 exhibited it and all are now fixed; it does not occur in horizontal writing. We reported it upstream (crbug 542686223) and Chromium fixed it. The rendering engine is now Chromium 153.0.8010.36. The bundled demo answers --version, so a problem report can identify the build exactly.We measured how many characters fit on one line; we did not measure how much room is left at the end of a column in multi-column layout.

entry.title: v1.2.1-build3 released
entry.summary: The build number is now available at run time when you report a problem. Until now, asking the library for its version returned only 1.2.1, with no build number. Behaviour can differ between builds of one version, and external users had no way to identify a build except by reading the package file name. blink_gtk_get_version_full() returns 1.2.1-build3; the return value of the existing blink_gtk_get_version() is unchanged. The frame-delivery log now records the operation actually performed and the Wayland buffer id, the measurement caps can be raised, and live render-path switching covers the EGL path (only when started with BLINKGTK_GPU_MODE=egl).

entry.title: v1.2.1-build2 released
entry.summary: Where the GPU path is unavailable — no driver, or no GPU visible inside a virtual machine — BlinkGTK now falls back to software rendering and keeps drawing. It switches when no frame arrives within five seconds and writes the reason to standard error, and it does not switch where the GPU path works. Captured screenshots no longer come out with red and blue exchanged.

entry.title: v1.2.1-build1 released
entry.summary: The rendering engine is updated to Chromium 152. In vertical writing, lines no longer break half-way when a closing bracket falls at the line end (a line with room for 34 characters held only 17), and columns now fill to capacity. The line grid is preserved with direction: rtl. Typeset output changes.

entry.title: v1.2.0-build9 released
entry.summary: Render paths can now be switched live, without restarting the application (the BlinkShift public API). A switch takes a few hundred milliseconds in our test environment and rolls back automatically if the new path fails its render check. Also adds blink_gtk_application_run() for correct GtkApplication integration and a presentation-policy API, and fixes large user scripts never reaching the renderer.

entry.title: v1.2.0-build8 released
entry.summary: Applied the results of a security review. Per-site process isolation is now on by default — the boundary that stops a compromised page reading another site's data. Opening several sites now uses more renderer processes, which can increase memory use. Sandbox availability is now measured rather than inferred, and there is a new API to query the sandbox state. A reference page for environment variables is also published.

entry.title: v1.2.0-build7 released
entry.summary: The header shipped with the development package claimed the previous release (this affects every v1.2.0 build from build1 through build6). The runtime API was always correct, so only compile-time macros were affected. Nothing includes that header, so builds kept succeeding — which is why it went unnoticed for so long. The runtime itself is identical to build6; Chromium was not rebuilt.

entry.title: v1.2.0-build6 released
entry.summary: The rendering engine is now Chromium 151.0.7922.108, fixing defects in the paths that close windows, hide windows, and handle input. User scripts you register now run before the page's own scripts, and JavaScript results come back as JSON.

entry.title: Western hyphenation now works
entry.summary: Specifying hyphens: auto now breaks Western words at appropriate points, with dictionaries for 52 languages bundled. Justified Western text depends on hyphenation, so previously the shorter the line the wider the word gaps became.

entry.title: Install and update with dnf
entry.summary: Register the repository once and dnf upgrade keeps you current. Packages are signed and the repository ships with gpgcheck=1.

entry.title: v1.2.0-build4 released
entry.summary: Continuously animating pages — Canvas, CSS animation, video — no longer freeze in software mode.

entry.title: GPU rendering works with a single environment variable
entry.summary: Switch to the GPU path with BLINKGTK_GPU_MODE=egl alone. No application code changes required.

entry.title: Reported a vertical-writing line-breaking issue upstream
entry.summary: In vertical writing, a closing bracket at the line end can leave the line half filled. Reported upstream with reproduction steps and measurements.

entry.title: Updated to Chromium 151
entry.summary: Emphasis marks no longer inflate line pitch, and ruby overhang behaves as specified.
